lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 4-5 visible vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits, arranged in a structured rectangular grid along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot alignments to form high-contrast anchor nodes, particularly prominent in the region posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to shadowed ventral pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast caustic light refractions are projected across the dorsal-anterior region of the head and upper flank.
